description: This file provides utility classes and functions for handling JSONL files with embedded newlines, replacing models in JSONL content, and determining metadata variable names based on router functions. It includes a custom in-memory file class, robust JSONL parsing, and helper functions tailored for specific API endpoints.

classes.name: InMemoryFile
classes.description: A subclass of io.BytesIO that includes additional metadata such as filename and content type for in-memory file representations.

methods.name: List[dict] parse_jsonl_with_embedded_newlines(content: str)
methods.description: Parses JSONL content containing JSON objects with embedded newlines, returning a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: bool should_replace_model_in_jsonl( purpose: OpenAIFilesPurpose, )
methods.description: Determines if the model name should be replaced in a JSONL file based on its purpose.

methods.name: FileTypes replace_model_in_jsonl(file_content: FileTypes, new_model_name: str)
methods.description: Replaces the model name within JSON objects in a JSONL file content, handling various content types and preserving embedded newlines.

methods.name: str _get_router_metadata_variable_name(function_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Returns the appropriate metadata variable name based on the associated router function name.
